question: After the native-block bug is fixed, should generic tool-progress intent become a supported public reply-payload plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The route omission has a narrow mechanical repair, but adding a permanent third-party-visible reply semantic is an API ownership choice that maintainers need to make explicitly.

options.title: Approve public progress intent
options.body: Keep TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload as the generic cross-plugin contract after route-complete tests and exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Carry the same closed producer-owned fact through a bundled internal seam without expanding the public plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve public progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload as the generic cross-plugin contract after route-complete tests and exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current architecture owning the affected Slack, Codex, and SDK paths and is the clearest available owner for the permanent API decision.
